description: Host-conforming massing block. Attach to a SPACE (from Space Properties): the building footprint is the space's own polygon — no plan-size parameters, mirroring the Flow Massing node. The `host` geometry rule is repeated once per floor (`n`), each instance lifted by `floorHeight`; `direction` extrudes Upward (Footprint, above ground) or Downward (Basement, below ground). `taper` steps the footprint in every `tierFloors` floors: 'setback' insets the host polygon `setbackM` metres per tier (parallel offset), 'area-ratio' scales it about its centroid so each tier holds `tierAreaRatio` of the area below. `blockGap` opens a void between adjacent floors. All geometry comes from the host polygon + these params via the generic engine — no per-object renderer code.

vars._doc: Constants shared by every floor. `dir` flips the stack up/down; `tf` clamps floors-per-tier; `gap` is the inter-floor void (kept below the floor height).

cases._doc: One host-extruded floor per `i` (0..nn-1). `inset` applies a parallel setback per tier (metres); `scale` shrinks about the centroid to an area ratio per tier (area scales as scale², so scale = sqrt(ratio)^tier). h0/h1 stack each floor by FH in `dir`, leaving `gap` as a void.
